name: Fuchinobe Sakura
source:
The shrine maiden's daughter is a black gal. She used to be ordinary, but one day she suddenly became a black gal. Even so, she still helps out at home (as a shrine maiden).

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_074.html#character]official site[/url]]
